text:
ken: Quick smoke ask from Verdance — they merged vd-lora-1 into their deployment and after we applied our int4-opt profile some invoice renders lose cents or swap separators. Can someone run a compatibility + int4-opt smoke (short pack, 26 examples)?

lina: on it. can you paste the 4 that tripped their QA?

ken: flagged examples they pasted: 
- Total: $6,780.90
- Factura: 6 780,90 \u00a0
- Amount: \u00a56,780.90
- Row: 6.780,90
They also noted a weird scientific-notation edge case: "6.78e3" appearing in a few templates after the merge.

joel: kicked a quick eval on host-shadow with rdx-base-3b, adapter=vd-lora-1, quant=int4-opt, samples=26. job id eva-1829999999-a. ETA ~7m.

eval-bot: queued eva-1829999999-a on runner-9. est runtime 6m.

joel: command used:
```
redwood eval run --model rdx-base-3b --adapter vd-lora-1 --quant int4-opt --tasks currency-format,numeric-precision --samples 26 --out /tmp/verdance-smoke.json
```

joel: quick topline: PPL(base)=11.6, PPL(merged)=12.4 (+6.9%). Failures: 6/26 numeric diffs (cents dropped or rounded to nearest 10/100), 3/26 token-boundary changes (space vs non-breaking-space vs dot), and 2/26 where output produced scientific notation like "6.78e3".

lina: scientific notation is an interesting twist. could vd-lora-1 have seen engineered features or tokens for exponents in their finetune?

joel: looked at tokenizer artifacts — Verdance said they used a space-as-thousands separator in their preprocess (i.e., non-breaking space \u00a0). Our hosted tokenizer normalizes NBSP to regular space but they trained with NBSP preserved. That explains some boundary diffs.

merge-helper: attached diff summary: token_diffs=9, top_logit_shifts_small=7, adapter_delta_norms: layer4 max=1.9, layer7 mean=0.68. See /artifacts/eva-1829999999-a/diff.txt

lina: re-ran with tokenizer_v2 and NBSP-preserve flag (tokenizers/tokenizer_v2 --preserve-nbsp) to simulate customer train pipeline. Result: PPL(merged,tokenizer_v2+nbsp)=11.9 (delta +2.6%), token diffs reduced to 2/26, scientific-notation cases persisted.

joel: ran int8 run to isolate quant effect: PPL(merged,int8)=11.7 (delta +0.9%), numeric mismatches dropped to 2/26 (no scientific-notation outputs). So int4-opt amplifies a low-prob tail that flips small tokens into exponent tokens in a couple templates.

ken: any sign adapter is overconfident on exponent tokens?

joel: inspected logits for one failing example: after int4-opt the relative logit gap between ",67" and "e3" token widened slightly in favor of "e3" due to quant noise mixing in certain head projections. Not huge but enough to change argmax. Also couple adapter delta rows >1.5 which make low-prob tokens brittle under quantization.

lina: local mitigation: tried a clamp-merge (clip adapter deltas to [-0.6,0.6]) and an educated token blacklist remap (disallow lone exponent token in numeric templates). Clamp + remap int4-opt run: PPL penalty ~+1.4%, numeric diffs reduced to 0/26, scientific-notation gone. I pushed a temp gist with the clamp merge and remap hack: https://gist.github.com/temp/verdance-clamp-remap-2026

ken: actionables: 1) ask Verdance for their exact tokenizer recipe and any preprocessing/feature-ops (they already admitted NBSP preservation and a postprocessing step that converts large numbers to scientific format in their training logs); 2) recommend retraining with NBSP-normalized data OR include tokenizer_v2+preserve-nbsp during adapter merge; 3) offer clamp-merge + token remap as a short-term mitigation; 4) add the 26 examples to onboarding-regress/verdance.json with tags ["currency-cents-loss","nbsp-sep","sci-notation"]; 5) add a note to the runbook about exponent-token brittleness under int4-opt.

joel: I'll open the onboarding ticket and attach eval artifacts + the clamp-remap gist. Also will run a small QAT-sim (fake-QAT noise sweep) to estimate sensitivity across quant seeds.

lina: FYI I already ran a quick QAT-sim (3 seeds): variability concentrated in the same tokenized locations; seed-stability is low where adapter delta norms >1.2. We'll document thresholds in the runbook.

merge-helper: created ticket RW-61234 assigned eng-ml/onboarding. Please request Verdance training seeds and the postproc scripts.

ken: marking thread as "smoke -> investigate (pending-customer)". thanks for the quick turnaround :clap:
